component.name: StrmQt
component.summary: Watch your Emby library on the big screen

description.p: StrmQt is a native Qt 6 client for Emby media servers, built for KDE Plasma and designed to be driven from the couch with a remote, a gamepad, or the keyboard.

ul.li: Hardware-accelerated playback through libmpv, with libVLC as a fallback engine
Ten-foot interface: home rails, library grids, series drill-down, and search
Resume playback, watched state, and favourites synchronised with the server
MPRIS2 media controls, so KDE Connect and the Plasma applet just work
Per-profile access tokens stored in KWallet, with a warned-about vault file as fallback
HDR-aware tone mapping and screensaver inhibition during playback

description.p: Adds saved profiles with a "Who's watching?" picker at startup, a music library that can be queried along several axes with a Songs tab and audio playlists, ReplayGain volume normalisation, picture-in- picture, and a restorable play queue. Gamepad sticks now stop seeking on release, toggle the view with L3, and set volume on the right stick.

A large correctness and performance pass throughout: focus restoration survives loading and refill stalls, search results keep a coherent lifecycle, image decoding moves off the GUI thread, playback position updates no longer storm the UI at frame rate, and credentials persist to an owner-only vault file when KWallet cannot be reached.

Fixes a review pass over input handling and playback session handoff: selection controls no longer disagree with the value they display, context menus return keyboard focus, queue edits after stop no longer restart playback, and a held gamepad stick commits one seek instead of one per repeat step.

The "first-party feel" release: mouse and pointer support throughout, live updates from the server, a play queue with shuffle and auto-advance, a full player OSD, library sorting and filtering, collections, playlists, person pages, remote control from other Emby clients, and music.
